d:
Todd Hoffman discovers monster nuggets high on a mountain, while Parker Schnabel and Rick Ness face trouble with a conveyor. Meanwhile, Tony Beets puts his daughter Monica and Kevin to the test in a head-to-head challenge to find out whether his dredge can outperform a modern washplant. Which mining operation will come out on top?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 19, on Discovery Channel India.
